caption: The drawing depicts a single metal pitcher or kettle, prominently placed in the center of the composition. The object is rendered in shades of brown and bronze, with shading that suggests a metallic surface and rounded, voluminous form. The pitcher has a broad, slightly squatted body, a short neck, and a lid with a small, ornate handle on top. Attached to the right side is a large, curved handle secured with visible rivets. The background is plain and light beige, providing contrast to the pitcher without any ambient objects or additional elements. The artist’s signature, "Ethel Clarke '39," is written in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Copper Water Vessel
